items.why: Volatility is up as stocks slide on Nvidia troubles and rising bond yields, per Bloomberg and Yahoo Finance.
AMD climbs as traders weigh the Nvidia CEO exit, per CNBC live updates.
Nvidia falls about 5% after CEO Jensen Huang resigned, per WSJ live updates.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: S&P futures are down 0.3% and Nasdaq futures are down 0.41%, with the 10-year yield up 2.1% to 5.10%.
summary: Stocks are lower this afternoon as Nvidia's CEO exit and rising bond yields roil markets. The VIX is jumping, Nvidia leads the slide, and AMD is the standout gainer.
